verdict.rationale: The pack has no documented user-facing controls for setting data retention periods or deleting stored data. The closest items are adjacent: a plan-level audit-log retention window ('up to 2 years'), Edge keeping targeting PII local, external metrics staying in the user's system, and self-hosting via Docker. None of these lets the user configure retention or trigger deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
